subject: Executive sponsor handshake + EB meeting slots for close plan
body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive sponsor handshake + EB meeting slots for close plan

Hi Sarah & team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited by the momentum. Attaching an updated mutual action plan (ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a short PDF with proposed EB meeting slots (EB_slot_proposals.pdf).

Quick asks so we can lock the close timeline:
- Please confirm the executive sponsor who will join the EB (name + title).
- Are the weeks of July 11 or July 18 feasible for a 60-90 minute EB? We propose two options so we can land one and book the room.
- Any additional exec attendees we should reserve time for? Sarah, if you can share a short attendee list that would help.

If sponsor confirms this week we’ll:
- Finalize MAP milestones (milestone dates in the XLSX)
- Publish an evaluation plan summary for the EB (success criteria + scoring rubrics)
- Draft run-of-show and ownership (who presents which sections)

I’ll sync with Marissa and Karthik on internal presenters — tagging them here to confirm roles.

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx, EB_slot_proposals.pdf

----------------------------------------
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor handshake + EB meeting slots for close plan

Thanks Avery — appreciate the materials. Quick answers:
- Sponsor: Jonathan Park, SVP Product Strategy (he will be the executive sponsor).
- Weeks: July 11 looks tight for Jonathan (QBR travel), July 18 is much better.
- Attendees: I attached a short internal attendee list (Acme_Attendee_List.docx). We’ll have Jessica (Head of Security) and Mark (Procurement) at the EB.

One important note: Jonathan asked that the evaluation plan highlight regulatory data controls and a short demo showing private deployment options. Can you surface those in the MAP and the EB agenda?

I can confirm formal sponsorship once I run this by Jonathan later today. If you can tentatively hold July 19 (Tuesday) 10:00–11:30 PT that would be ideal.

—Sarah
Sarah Lin
Senior Dir, AI Strategy | Acme Corp
sarah.lin@acme.com | +1 617-555-0133

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: EB run-of-show + presentation owners (Acme)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sarah’s reply (below). Jonathan is the exec sponsor if confirmed; they want emphasis on regulatory controls + private deploy demo. Sarah asked to tentatively hold July 19, 10:00–11:30 PT.

Proposed split of ownership:
- Exec overview & business impact (Marissa) — 15 min
- Security & compliance deep dive (Karthik) — 25 min (include KMS/HSM, data residency, audit logs)
- Private deployment demo (Infra PM + Solutions Engineer) — 20 min
- Q&A + procurement next steps (Avery + Marissa) — 20 min

MAP milestones we should confirm in the XLSX: pilot start (8/1), security review complete (7/26), procurement sign-off (8/15). I’ve updated ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx with these dates.

Also want to prepare a 2-slide evaluation rubric summary for the EB: success metrics, pass/fail thresholds, and a short list of test prompts for quality checks. Can one of you take lead on the rubric slide?

If July 19 is good for the exec sponsor, I’ll send a formal invite and the EB agenda.

Thanks — Avery

----------------------------------------
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: EB run-of-show + presentation owners (Acme)

That split looks good — happy to handle the exec overview and procurement framing. I’ll own the two-slide rubric summary (first pass by EOD).

Karthik, can you prepare the compliance slide set and a one-page appendix with the specific artifacts we’ll show (SOC 2 report, audit logs, KMS diagram)? I’ll coordinate with Solutions Eng to scope the private deployment demo — we should rehearse the handoff between Marissa -> SE -> Karthik.

I’ll draft the calendar invite once Avery confirms July 19 with Sarah (we should set a tentative Teams link and include the MAP XLSX and rubric slides).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0224
